title: Pan-Seared Norwegian Cod with Spicy Dumplings
description: A flavorful and spicy dish featuring pan-seared Norwegian cod served with a side of crispy spicy dumplings. Perfect for a fish lover's dinner.

ingredients.name: Spicy Seasoning
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika

instructions: Rinse the cod fillets and pat dry with paper towels.
Season the cod with salt, pepper, and spicy seasoning.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the cod fillets to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, prepare the dumpling mix according to package instructions.
Form the dumpling mixture into small balls and flatten slightly.
Heat butter in a separate skillet over medium heat.
Add the dumplings to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side or until golden brown.
Serve the cod with spicy dumplings and a squeeze of lemon juice.
